title: Intelligent Sensor Nail Baking Lamp
body_html:
Nail UV LED Lamp Product Description

Product Overview

This SUN X5 MAX nail lamp is a high-power 150W nail curing light equipped with 45 lamp beads. It supports intelligent automatic induction and multi-period timing functions, which can quickly cure various UV gel nail polish. The built-in low heat mode effectively reduces the heat sensation during use and brings a more comfortable manicure experience.

This nail dryer is suitable for nail salons and home DIY manicure. Multiple plug standards are available, including US plug, EU plug. White and pink housing colors are optional to meet diverse purchasing demands for bulk orders.

Key Features

  1. 150W High Power & 45 Lamp Beads for Quick Curing

    Built with 45 high-quality UV/LED dual light source beads, the total power reaches 150W. It delivers uniform light distribution, rapidly curing base coat, color gel, top coat and builder gel. Greatly shorten nail making time and improve work efficiency.

  2. Intelligent Auto Sensor & Multi Timing Settings

    Adopts smart infrared sensor. The light automatically turns on when hands are placed inside and shuts down after taking hands out. It comes with four preset timers: 10s, 30s, 60s and 99s low heat mode, flexible for different nail gel materials. The large digital display clearly shows countdown time.

  3. Low Heat Protection Mode

    The exclusive 99s low heat mode can relieve hot feeling when curing thick gel. It avoids discomfort caused by heat conduction and prevents nail surface scorching, friendly to customers with sensitive nails.

  4. Multiple Specifications & Wide Application

    Available in white and pink appearance. Supports US plug, EU plug and other power adapters. Perfect for professional nail salon use and personal home nail art DIY. Suitable for wholesale, cross-border distribution and bulk procurement.

Safe material & Guaranteed: Our sleeping pad for camping is certified by CertiPUR-US and OEKO-TEX STANDARD 100. Safer material, healthier life. The memory foam, high density poly foam, and plush fabric cover are all made of safe material. The product is suitable for pregnant women and infants. Make your outdoor activities more environmentally friendly and healthy.

Easy to carry & Be versatile: It is very convenient to roll. And we will provide you with the appropriate travel bag. It can be rolled up and carried in a bag in seconds. Perfect for indoor and any outdoor activities, in the living room can be used by guests. It is placed on the indoor floor where children can climb and play. Suitable for families out on a trip camping. You can also carry it to participate in outdoor hiking sports. The bottom is designed to be waterproof and non-slip.
